title: Proper direct image on ind-constructible sheaves
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of positive characteristic different from $\ell$. Let $X,Y$ be separated schemes of finite type over $k$, and let $p\colon X\to Y$ be a proper $k$-morphism [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting, def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite subextension of a fixed algebraic closure $\Qlb$. Take $\Lambda=\underline E$ or $\underline{\Qlb}$ with the condensed coefficient conventions of [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]; the latter is the finite-subextension-valued condensed ring. For $T=X,Y$, put $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and work in $\Mod_{\Lambda_T}$ [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Write $\Cons(T,\Lambda)$ for constructible module sheaves [sk-def-sfb-constructible], and define $\IndCons(T,\Lambda)$ to be the full subcategory of module sheaves isomorphic to small filtered colimits of objects of $\Cons(T,\Lambda)$, computed in $\Mod_{\Lambda_T}$.

Let $d\in\mathbf Z$ bound the Krull dimensions [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension] of all geometric fibres [def-weil-geometric-fibre] of $p$. Let $Rp_*$ be the ordinary derived module pushforward [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull], and put $R^qp_*M=\mathcal H^q(Rp_*(M[0]))$, with cohomology sheaves as in [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves]. For every $M\in\IndCons(X,\Lambda)$ and $q\ge0$, $R^qp_*M\in\IndCons(Y,\Lambda)$ and $R^qp_*M=0$ if $q>2d+1$. Moreover for every small family $(M_i)_{i\in I}$ in $\IndCons(X,\Lambda)$, the canonical map
$$
\bigoplus_{i\in I}R^qp_*M_i\longrightarrow R^qp_*\Bigl(\bigoplus_{i\in I}M_i\Bigr)
$$
is an isomorphism in $\IndCons(Y,\Lambda)$; the sums are the ambient module-sheaf sums.

proof.text: The continuity theorem requires $p$ to be quasi-compact and quasi-separated. By [def-weil-proper-morphism], $p$ is of finite type and has a closed-immersion diagonal. Finite type includes quasi-compactness [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]. By the affine description of a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], the inverse image of an affine open under the diagonal is affine, hence quasi-compact. Thus the diagonal is quasi-compact, which is exactly quasi-separatedness [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism].

source.place: first paragraph: elementary verification of the qcqs hypothesis of continuity

proof.text:
By the definition of $\IndCons$ in the statement, choose a small filtered diagram $(C_\alpha)$ of constructible $\Lambda_X$-modules and an isomorphism $M\simeq\varinjlim_\alpha C_\alpha$ in the ambient module category. Apply [det-proper-heart-continuity-direct-image] to $A=\Lambda_X$ and the qcqs morphism of Step 1. Its natural comparison gives
$$
R^qp_*M\simeq\varinjlim_\alpha R^qp_*C_\alpha.
$$
All these are sheaves of $\Lambda_Y$-modules for the pulled-back coefficient system fixed in the statement.

A constructible sheaf $C_\alpha$ placed in degree zero is bounded constructible: its only possibly nonzero cohomology sheaf is $C_\alpha$, by the definition [sk-def-sfb-bounded-constructible]. Our coefficients are $E$ or $\Qlb$, and $p$ is proper between the standing schemes specified in the statement. Consequently clause (2) of [det-thm-sfb-proper-base-change-rational] gives $Rp_*C_\alpha\in\Dbc(Y,\Lambda)$. The same bounded-constructible definition says that $R^qp_*C_\alpha$ is constructible for every $q$. The small filtered colimit of these sheaves in Step 2 is, by our definition of $\IndCons$, an object of $\IndCons(Y,\Lambda)$.

If $q>2d+1$, [det-proper-heart-bound-rational] applies to every $C_\alpha$: the coefficient choice, proper morphism and geometric-fibre bound are exactly those of the statement. It gives $R^qp_*C_\alpha=0$ for every $\alpha$. In the colimit identification of Step 2 the whole diagram is therefore zero; its colimit is zero by the colimit universal property. Hence $R^qp_*M=0$.

For a small family $(M_i)$ in $\IndCons(X,\Lambda)$, [det-ind-heart-filtered-colimits] applied on $X$ shows that its ambient sum is again in $\IndCons(X,\Lambda)$. Thus Step 3 applies both to every $M_i$ and to their sum. The direct-sum assertion of [det-proper-heart-continuity-direct-image], with the qcqs hypothesis verified in Step 1, says precisely that the canonical map in the statement is an isomorphism of ambient module sheaves. By [det-ind-heart-filtered-colimits] on $Y$, its source is in $\IndCons(Y,\Lambda)$; its target is there by Step 3. Since $\IndCons$ is a full subcategory, this ambient isomorphism and its inverse are morphisms in it. For the same reason an ambient sum whose object lies in this full subcategory satisfies its coproduct universal property there. This proves preservation of arbitrary direct sums in $\IndCons$.
